Use case: identity-preserve. Asset: whole-figure PIXEL ART walk sprites for the existing native64 square-grid roguelike. Input1 is the EXACT APPEARANCE, VIEW, ANATOMY, COLORS and PROPORTIONS master to preserve. Input2 is an accepted COMPACT BIPED GAIT guide ONLY. Do not copy its orange color, large fists, horn shape, proportions or species. Animate only the existing master creature.
Layout exactly THREE equal columns by THREE equal rows. First eight separate WHOLE FIGURES in row-major order form one smooth 800ms walking cycle, 400ms per advancement; ninth figure is a real two-feet-grounded idle. All figures have identical camera, scale, anatomy, height and framing. Generous transparent cell margins, complete horns/fingers/claws/feet, no clipping or overlap.
First eight phases:1left-foot contact/right-foot behind,2weight settles on left-foot support,3right foot passes LOW near grounded left foot,4right foot sets down slightly ahead,5right support/opposite contact,6settles on right foot,7left passes LOW near grounded right foot,8left sets down. Small forward/back travel, narrow stance, visible bent knees and deliberate weight shift. One support is grounded at every transition. Not a run, hop, march, broad split, tiptoe or legs sliding apart. Hands swing VERY slightly opposite the legs, close to the body; claws never support weight. Head, neck, spine and torso stay coherently attached with tiny bob. Preserve the master posture and body proportions; no body bulking, no extra limb, no weapon or anatomy invented.
Game camera has slight elevation and the exact frontal/rear projection of input1; parallel square-grid axes, not side-view or an isometric diamond. Match native64 readability with crisp deliberate pixel clusters, muted matte materials and deep original dark outlines. Do NOT brighten the skin, bleach the bone, add shine, rimlight, glow, blur, grain, gradients or a 3D render. Colored fringe specks in input1 are export specks, not accessories.
Genuine transparent alphaZERO everywhere outside each coherent figure and through gaps; no matte, checkerboard, ground, shadow, grid, text, labels or watermark. Change gait only; keep identity, material coverage, asymmetry and colors from input1.
Native complete silhouette is 41px WIDE x 47px HIGH, width/height=0.872; keep this ratio and individual limb lengths, including during passing poses.

VIEW FRONT/slight frontal three-quarter, walking DOWN/TOWARD viewer, just like input1. Keep original face, chest material coverage and all existing frontal features.
